meta.name: Gender Reveal Voting App
meta.notes: v3: WCAG 2.2 AA pass — fixed muted-foreground and switch-track contrast (SC 1.4.3 / 1.4.11), added focus-visible outline tokens (SC 2.4.7 / 2.4.11), added minimum tap-target size (SC 2.5.8, new in 2.2), added reduced-motion handling for looping animations (SC 2.2.2).

display.usage: H1 only — hero title, reveal moment, primary CTA. Single weight, no bold/italic available.

subheading.usage: H2-H4, buttons, form labels, vote counters. Retro CRT-terminal feel, far more legible than the display font at UI sizes.

body.usage: Paragraphs, inputs, long-form copy. Rounded and warm, pairs with VT323, actually readable for sentences.

fontWeight.note: Press Start 2P and VT323 are single-weight fonts; weight tokens apply to Nunito (body) only.

light.mutedForegroundContrast: 4.8:1 on page background (AA pass) — was #6b6b6b at 3.0:1 (fail)
light.switchBackgroundContrast: 4.4:1 vs white card (AA pass, SC 1.4.11) — was #e0e0e0 at 1.3:1 (fail)

dark.switchBackgroundContrast: 3.6:1 vs card (AA pass, SC 1.4.11) — was #4a3670 at 1.5:1 (fail)

radius.note: All flattened to 0px for pixel-art consistency; original file had negative values from an unadjusted shadcn formula.

wcagCriteria: 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured, Minimum (AA, new in 2.2)

tapTargetMinimum.appliesTo: buttons, links styled as buttons, checkboxes/radios, switches, text inputs, selects. Inline text links are exempt per spec.

reducedMotion.handling: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables pixel-float/pulse/blink and the CRT scanline overlay

effects.pixelBorder: 4px hard-edged 4-directional box-shadow, no blur, uses border color
effects.crtScanlines: repeating-linear-gradient overlay, 4px pitch, 15% black opacity, z-index 100
